text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Group revenues to grow at 15% for FY26.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2025",
      "quote": "Our group order inflows and group revenues to grow at 10% and 15% respectively for FY26.",
      "outcome": "FY26 revenue reached ₹285,874 Cr, representing 11.7% growth over FY25 (₹255,734 Cr).",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Annual Financials Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Group order inflows to grow at 10% for FY26.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2025",
      "quote": "Our group order inflows and group revenues to grow at 10% and 15% respectively for FY26.",
      "outcome": "Management reported 33% growth in Q1, 45% in Q2, and confidence in exceeding 10% by Oct 2025.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY26 and Q2 FY26 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Net Working Capital-to-Revenue at 12% by March 2026.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2025",
      "quote": "Our Net Working Capital-to-Revenue guidance for March ‘26 remains at 12%.",
      "outcome": "Reported Net Working Capital to Revenue was 8.2% in Jan 2026 (Q3 FY26).",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Q3 FY26 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Target 8.3% to 8.5% margin for Projects and Manufacturing in FY26.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2025",
      "quote": "we continue to target the 8.3% to 8.5% range for the full year FY26.",
      "outcome": "Reported PM margins were 7.6% in Q1 and 8.1% in Q3 FY26.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY26 and Q3 FY26 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Exceed 10% growth in group order inflows for FY26.",
      "made_in": "Oct 2025",
      "quote": "We are confident of exceeding our full year FY26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows for the current year.",
      "outcome": "Order book grew from ₹6.13 trillion (Jul 2025) to ₹7.40 trillion (May 2026).",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY26 and Q4 FY26 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Divestment of Hyderabad Metro and Nabha Power to close in Q1 FY27.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "We expect both the transactions to achieve closure this quarter, that is Q1 FY '27.",
      "outcome": "No mention of closure in the Q1 FY27 (Jul 2026) reported metrics.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY27 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Improved execution momentum moving into FY27.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "We are hopeful that this trend will sustain with the execution momentum improving as we move into FY27.",
      "outcome": "Q1 FY27 revenue was ₹67,942 Cr (7% YoY), but Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026) rose to ₹78,750 Cr (16% YoY).",
      "verdict": "partly",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Jun 2026 / Sep 2026"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 3,
    "partly": 1,
    "missed": 2,
    "summary": "Management consistently over-delivers on order inflows and working capital efficiency but tends to over-promise on revenue growth and specific segment margins."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Order inflow narrative is consistently supported by massive growth in the reported order book reaching ₹7.79 trillion by Q1 FY27.",
    "Revenue growth narrative of 15% for FY26 diverged from the actual 11.7% achieved for the full year.",
    "Margin guidance for Projects & Manufacturing (8.3-8.5%) remained aspirational, as reported quarterly figures (7.6-8.1%) consistently lagged the target.",
    "Working capital management narrative is highly credible, with actual ratios (8.2%) significantly better than the 12% guidance."
  ]
}
